integrity: The infinite root bound and equality classification have complete integer-lattice proofs. Finite diagnostics test examples only. No independent external verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complex lattice-polarized existence, not an explicit sextic equation; classifies smooth rational curves only. Singular rational curves and the complete splitting locus of plane curves are outside scope. Priority of older specialist constructions is not absolutely excluded.
title: Six shortest rational curves on double-plane K3 surfaces from a rank-four Sierpiński lattice
